name: legal.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  legal.scss — view-legal scoped styles: the legal document article inside
//  the internals chrome + legal footer (adopted into the shadow root).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/placeholders';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/structure';
@import '../../../core/sass/components/home/awards-footer';

// ── Legal Document Isolated Styles ───────────────────────────────────────────
$_B_INTERNAL: 'internal';

:host {
  display: block;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

article {
  display: block;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

.legal {
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

.#{$_B_INTERNAL}-title {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  @extend .ttl-lg;
  @extend .ttl-special;

  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
  color: var(--text-primary);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  span {
    display: inline-block;
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
}

// The legal document column — narrows to a readable measure as the viewport
// grows: full gutter on phone, 12.5% side insets on tablet, 25% on desktop
// (~50% column = optimal legal-text line length), then re-widens on 1920+
// where %MAXAREA's max-width takes over instead.
.#{$_B_INTERNAL}-description {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding-left: 12.5%;
    padding-right: 12.5%;
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding-left: 25%;
    padding-right: 25%;
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  &:last-of-type {
    @include layout-1024() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-6xl);
    }
  }

  &-text {
    @extend .txt-md;

    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 100;
    word-break: normal;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
    hyphens: none;
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    color: var(--text-secondary);

    @include layout-768() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
  }
}
